standard_prerequisites.use: Gives ampleness on each piece, hence globally.

core_obligations: Reduce to an affine open covering of the base (proof lines 8918-8922).
Choose the covering subordinate to affine opens of the original base and observe the morphism between preimages is affine (proof lines 8922-8926).
Apply the affine pullback result and conclude (proof lines 8927-8929).
proof_roadmap: Affineness of the morphism between preimages (proof lines 8922-8926).
Pullback along an affine morphism (proof lines 8927-8929).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the pullback of an invertible sheaf which is ample for a morphism remains ample for the base change of that morphism. The proof uses the criterion that ampleness may be checked after an affine open covering of the base, chooses the covering subordinate to affine opens of the original base, notes that the morphism between the corresponding preimages is affine as a base change of an affine morphism, and then applies the lemma on pulling back ample sheaves along an affine morphism.
